anchors.paper_title: Conflict acts as an implicit cost in reinforcement learning
anchors.reason: The candidate paper, 'Conflict acts as an implicit cost in reinforcement learning,' describes the task concept (Simon conflict) but does not introduce or describe the specific EEG dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG data were collected during a Simon conflict task adapted from established protocols. Parkinson's disease patients completed two sessions separated by one week, tested under both ON and OFF medication states. Control subjects completed a single session. Accelerometer data (X, Y, Z dimensions) were simultaneously recorded from the most tremor-affected hand in Parkinson's patients. Task stimuli were presented using MATLAB programming language.
